fields.Damage: 2d6 Acid on a failed save.
fields.Range: One visible creature or object within 20 ft.
fields.Activation: Replace one attack during the Attack action to throw the item.
fields.Saving throw: Dexterity DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus.

fields.Damage: 1d4 Fire on a failed save, and the target starts burning.
fields.Range: One visible creature or object within 20 ft.
fields.Activation: Replace one attack during the Attack action to throw the item.
fields.Saving throw: Dexterity DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus.

fields.Damage: 2d8 Radiant to a Fiend or Undead on a failed save.
fields.Activation: Replace one attack during the Attack action to throw the item.
fields.Saving throw: Dexterity DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus.

fields.Damage: An oiled target that takes Fire damage before the oil dries takes 5 extra Fire. Ignited ground oil deals 5 Fire per turn to a creature that enters or ends its turn in the area.
fields.Range: Throw up to 20 ft, or oil a 5 ft square of level ground within 5 ft.
fields.Activation: Replace an attack to throw it, or take the Utilize action to pour it.
fields.Saving throw: Dexterity DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus. Applies to a creature or object targeted by the throw.
fields.Duration: Oil on a target dries after 1 minute. Burning ground oil lasts 2 rounds. One flask fuels a lamp or lantern for up to 6 hours.

fields.Damage: No direct damage.
fields.Activation: Replace one attack during the Attack action to throw the item.
fields.Saving throw: Dexterity DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus. Huge or larger creatures succeed automatically.
fields.Special powers: Failure Restrains the target. The target or a creature within 5 ft can use an action to free it with a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. Destroying the net also frees it. Net AC 10, 5 HP, immune to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic.

fields.Damage: 1 Fire damage on a hit.
fields.Range: Melee; light extends 20 ft bright plus 20 ft dim.
fields.Activation: Attack with a lit torch as a Simple Melee weapon.

fields.Attack bonus: +1 to attack and damage. The piece loses its magic after a hit.

fields.Damage: Dagger damage +1. A coated hit can add 2d10 Poison.
fields.Activation: Make a dagger attack. Use a Bonus Action to coat it once per dawn.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Constitution or take the poison damage and become Poisoned for 1 minute.
fields.Duration: The coating lasts until a hit against a creature or 1 minute.

fields.Damage: Base weapon damage plus the portion of its +3 bonus retained for attacks.
fields.Range: Use the base weapon’s reach or range.
fields.Activation: Make an attack with the weapon.
fields.Special powers: On your first attack each turn, you can move some or all of the +3 attack and damage bonus to AC until your next turn starts, while holding the weapon.

fields.Damage: Base weapon damage +1, plus 3d6 of the same damage type against a Dragon.
fields.Range: Use the base weapon’s reach or range.
fields.Activation: Make an attack with the weapon.

fields.Damage: Warhammer damage +3. A thrown hit adds 1d8 Force, or 2d8 Force against a Giant.
fields.Activation: Make an attack with the weapon.
fields.Special powers: Returns immediately after a ranged hit or miss.

fields.Damage: Base weapon damage +3, plus 2d10 Radiant against a Fiend or Undead.
fields.Range: Use the base weapon’s reach or range.
fields.Activation: Make an attack with the weapon.
fields.Special powers: While drawn and held, you and Friendly creatures in the Emanation have Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
fields.Area: 10 ft Emanation centered on you. Increases to 30 ft at Paladin level 17.

fields.Damage: Normal javelin damage; a hit may deal Lightning instead of Piercing. The special line deals 4d6 Lightning, halved on a successful save.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee or 30/120 ft thrown. The special line reaches a target up to 120 ft away.
fields.Activation: Attack normally, or once per dawn forgo the ranged attack roll to activate the line.
fields.Area: 5 ft wide line to the target. Affects the target and other creatures in the line, excluding you.
fields.Saving throw: DC 13 Dexterity against the line.
fields.Special powers: Reappears in your hand after the line resolves.

fields.Damage: Mace damage, plus 2d6 Radiant against a Fiend or Undead.
fields.Activation: Make an attack with the weapon.
fields.Saving throw: A Fiend or Undead left at 25 HP or less after the extra damage makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Failure destroys it; success leaves it Frightened until the end of your next turn.
fields.Area: While held, 20 ft bright light plus 20 ft dim light.

fields.Damage: Mace damage +1, or +3 against Constructs. On an attack roll of 20, add 7 Bludgeoning, or 14 against a Construct.
fields.Activation: Make an attack with the weapon.
fields.Attack bonus: +1 to attack and damage, or +3 against Constructs.
fields.Special powers: A Construct left at 25 HP or less after the special damage is destroyed.

fields.Damage: Normal mace damage on a weapon hit. The terror wave deals no damage.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee; terror wave affects chosen creatures within 30 ft.
fields.Activation: Attack normally or take a Magic action and spend one of 3 charges. Regain 1d3 expended charges at dawn.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Wisdom; repeat at the end of each turn.
fields.Special powers: Affected creatures flee, cannot make Opportunity Attacks, and can use their action only to Dash or escape restraint; if unable to move, they may Dodge.

fields.Damage: Scimitar damage +2.
fields.Activation: Attack normally or make one attack as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

fields.Damage: Longsword damage converted to Radiant, +2, and +1d8 Radiant against Undead.
fields.Activation: Use a Bonus Action to create or dismiss the blade; attack while it exists.
fields.Special powers: Longsword with Finesse. Longsword or Shortsword proficiency applies.
fields.Area: Sunlight: initially 15 ft bright plus 15 ft dim. A Magic action adjusts both radii by 5 ft, within 10–30 ft each.

fields.Damage: Normal trident damage. The spell deals no direct damage.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee or 20/60 ft thrown; Dominate Beast uses its spell range.
fields.Activation: Attack normally, or spend 1 of 3 charges to cast Dominate Beast on a Beast with a Swim Speed. Regain 1d3 expended charges at dawn.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 for the spell.
